home.title: Citizens
home.hint: One discussion, or a programme of several with the same people? Everything underneath — tables, QR codes, live view, transcripts, report — is the same, and a Session can become an Assembly later.
home.readyBody: The browser did not open it by itself — open it here, on this phone.
home.recordNowHint: This phone, one table, no set-up. Recording in seconds.
home.startSessionHint: One discussion at several tables, once. A question, QR codes, you start and end it.
home.createAssemblyHint: An event: several sessions, the same participants, one report across them.

assemblyWizard.title: Create assembly
assemblyWizard.intro: An event made of several sessions with the same group of people: participants, seating, one report across the sessions.
assemblyWizard.name: Assembly name
assemblyWizard.orchestratedHint: You start and end each session for all tables at once; phones record simultaneously.
assemblyWizard.independentHint: Each table records the shared questions on its own schedule — even days apart.
assemblyWizard.plenaryHint: The whole room is one discussion. Any number of phones scan one code and record it together from different spots; the recordings are merged into a single transcript. Also for a personal in-person meeting recorder.
assemblyWizard.analysis: AI analysis instructions for this assembly (optional)
assemblyWizard.analysisPlaceholder: E.g. This assembly is about urban mobility. 'PUMS' means the city's mobility plan.
assemblyWizard.analysisHint: Given to the AI when analyzing this assembly's discussions — topic context, local glossary, focus areas.
assemblyWizard.tableCountWarning: At least one table — each one gets a QR code, and phones join by scanning it.
assemblyWizard.question: Question / prompt
assemblyWizard.questionPlaceholder: What mobility problems do people experience?

sessionWizard.title: Start a Session
sessionWizard.intro: One discussion, at one or more tables, once. Add tables and recorder phones while it runs; if you later want a second session, the Session becomes an Assembly.
sessionWizard.question: Question
sessionWizard.objectiveHint: What the discussion should produce, as distinct from what it is about.
sessionWizard.orchestratedHint: You start and end the Session for every table at once.
sessionWizard.independentHint: Every table starts and stops when it is ready — even on different days.
sessionWizard.plenaryHint: The whole room is one discussion; any number of phones record it together.

detail.deleteMessage: “{name}” and all of its sessions, transcripts and reports will be permanently deleted — including every audio file stored on the server.

qr.downloadFailed: The sheet could not be downloaded — check the pop-up blocker
qr.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the link text instead
qr.sharedCodeHint: One shared code for the whole room. Any number of phones scan it to record together. Re-viewable and re-printable here anytime.
qr.tableCodesHint: One code per physical table. Codes can be re-viewed and re-printed here anytime.
qr.printKitTitle: A card per table with its colour and code, the programme and the recording notice — print the evening before
qr.addTableTitle: Add the next table to every session
qr.partialSheet: Showing {shown} of {active} table codes — the rest were issued under a different app secret and cannot be re-displayed. Regenerate to get a complete sheet, which revokes the current codes.
qr.staleCodes: {active} of {total} table codes active, but they were issued before re-viewing existed — regenerate to obtain new QR codes.
qr.emptyHint: Generate one recording code per table, print the sheet, and place one code on each physical table.
qr.scanHint: Scan with the table recording phone
qr.regenerateMessage: All {count} codes already printed and placed on the tables stop working immediately, and a new sheet has to be printed and distributed. Tables already recording keep their session.
qr.revokeMessage: Every printed or shared QR code stops working immediately. Phones already recording keep their session.
